Recovery and truthfulness

What the statuses mean

handoff ready means bytes are prepared locally and hashed; nothing is published.
submitted / pending confirmation are Publisher-reported states and remain unverified.
remote verified requires an exact read-back whose SHA-256 and byte length match the handoff.
ambiguous means Qortal replied without a definitive per-resource result, or read-back disagreed; reconcile manually and never auto-resubmit.
failed / declined / blocked are preserved for an explicit, user-approved retry. This desktop app does not publish or retry in the background.
